v1.82.2a (19 December 2025) |feed_title = ❄️ FROST MODE ❄️ |feed_color = Beige |previous_update = [[v1.81.0]] |next_update = [[v1.83.0|The Final Act Update]] }} ==Description== '''v1.82.0''' is the one hundred and thirty-fourth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 3rd of December 2025. This update was also given the name '''Frost Mode Update''', as this update added [[Frost Mode]]. This update encompassed nine versions, the main v1.82.0 update (released 3 December 2025) and eight minor updates, the v1.82.0a (released 4 December 2025), v1.82.0b (released 4 December 2025), v1.82.0c (released 4 December 2025), v1.82.0d (released 4 December 2025), v1.82.0e (released 9 December 2025) v1.82.1 (released 11 December 2025), v1.82.2 (released 12 December 2025) and v1.82.2a (released 19 December 2025). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *Modern enemies: **[[Mega Frost Mystery]] **[[Permafrost]] **[[Frostmite]] **[[Frost Acolyte]] **[[Trickster Elf]] **[[Yeti]] **[[Frost Wraith]] *Legacy enemy: **[[Yeti (Village of Despair)|Yeti]] ===Maps=== *[[Northern Lights]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Frost Mode]] ==Removals== *[[Korblox Necromancer]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Frozen]] changed. **Speed decreased from Slightly Fast (4.5) to Above Average (4). **[[Defense]] removed. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. *[[Snowy]] changed. **Health increased from 8 to 14 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Speed increased from Slightly Fast (4.5) to Fast (6.25). **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. *[[Packed Ice]] changed. **Speed decreased from Above Average (3.5) to Average (3). **[[Defense]] decreased from 100% to 50%. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **Size decreased. *[[Snow Minion]] changed. **Speed decreased from Slightly Fast (5.5) to Above Average (3.8). **''Snowball Throw'' stun time increased from 1 to 2. **Size increased. *[[Frost Mystery]] changed. **Speed decreased from Above Average (3.5) to Slightly Fast (5.4). **Appearance changed. **Health decreased from 50 to 40 health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Icebreaker'' ability changed. ***Number of enemies spawned decreased from 5 to 1. ***Now summons [[Snowman]] and [[Frostmite]]. ***No longer summons [[Snowy]], [[Frozen]] or [[Snow Minion]]. ***[[Packed Ice]] chance increased from 10% to 33%. *[[Cold Mist]] changed. **Speed decreased from 4 to 3.6. **Appearance changed. **Health increased from 125 to 200 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *[[Frost Hunter]] changed. **[[Defense]] of 30% added. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **Health increased from 500 to 2,250 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Size increased. **''Javelin Throw'' ability changed. ***Now freezes towers. ***Damage to units increased from 150 to 800. *[[Unstable Ice]] changed. **Health increased from 100 to 600 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Avalanche'' ability changed. ***Now stuns towers instead of freezing them. ***Explosion range increased from 5 to 6. ***Stun time decreased from 3 to 2. *[[Crying Angel]] changed. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **Health increased from 125 to 350 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *[[Frost Undead]] changed. **[[Defense]] removed. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **Health increased from 800 to 2,800 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *[[Frost Invader]] changed. **[[Defense]] removed. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **Health increased from 450 to 4,500 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Size increased. *[[Frost Ravager]] changed. **Has 6,500 [[Shield Health]]. **Speed decreased from Average (3) to Slightly Slow (2.25). **[[Defense]] decreased from 80% to 40%. **Health increased from 8,000 to 15,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Leading Dash'' ability changed. ***Speed boost is now gained 2 seconds after spawning, rather than happening once its [[Shield Health]] runs out. ***Speed boost no longer disappears after a set amount of time, instead it will stop running few seconds after losing all of its [[Shield Health]]. ***Speed increased from Slightly Fast (4.5) to Fast (7.5). *[[Frost Mage]] changed. **[[Burn Immunity]] added. **Health increased from 5,000 to 9,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Ice Projectile'' ability changed. ***Freeze time increased from 2 to 3. ***Damage to units increased from 250 to 1,600. ***Explosion range increased from 5 to 7. *[[Frost Hero]] changed. **Speed decreased from Below Average (2.5) to Slightly Slow (2.15). **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **Size increased. **''Crystalized Slash'' ability changed. ***Stun time increased from 3 to 5.5. ***Unit damage increased from 150 to 1,000. ***Cooldown increased from 10 to 15. *[[Frost Necromancer]] changed. **Speed decreased from Below Average (2.75) to Slightly Slow (2). **[[Defense]] removed. **[[Stun Immunity]] removed. **''Forbidden Arts'' ability changed. ***Now has a 60% chance to summon in [[Frost Undead]], 10% chance for [[Unstable Ice]] and 30% chance for the [[Mega Frost Mystery]] instead of just spawning [[Frost Undead]]s. ***Enemies now have a 15% chance to be [[Nimble]] instead of 5%, 20% chance to be [[Aggro]], 15% chance to be [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and 50% chance to have the [[Freeze Immunity]]. ***Enemies can no longer spawn with nothing or [[Bloated]]. ***Cooldown increased from 15 to 26.5. *[[Deep Freeze]] changed. **Speed changed from Average (3) to Below Average (2.75). **[[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] added. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **Death animation added. **Size increased. *[[Frost Spirit]] changed. **[[Stun Immunity]] removed. **Health increased from 100,000 to 500,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Frost Spikes'' ability changed. ***Freeze time decreased from 5 to 3.5. ***Damage decreased from 2,000 to 1,600. ***Cooldown increased from 15 to 25. **''Ice Storm'' ability changed. ***Freeze time decreased from 5 to 4. ***Damage decreased from 1,000 to 825. ***Icicle count increased from 25 to 45. ***Cooldown increased from 30 to 75. ***Attack cooldown decreased from 5 to 1. **''Summon'' ability changed. ***Number of enemies spawned increased from six to nine. ***[[Frost Mage]] chance decreased from 40% to 5% and delay increased from 0.75 to 1.5. ***[[Frost Invader]] chance decreased from 45% to 20% and delay decreased from 0.5 to 0.25. ***No longer summons in the [[Frost Hero]]. ***Now summons the [[Frost Undead]] (35% chance, 0.25 delay) and [[Frost Hunter]] (40% chance, 0.75 delay). ***Cooldown increased from 20 to 45. ***Attack cooldown increased from 5 to 10. **''Antarctic Armageddon'' ability changed. ***Now triggers at 60% of its health instead of 75%. ***No longer temporarily gives [[Flying]]. Instead, it now makes it temporarily immune to damage. ***Now gives the [[Frost Spirit]] a new appearance by changing its halo, wings and collar. **''Ice Beacon'' ability changed. ***Health regeneration is 2,000 every second in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. ***Cooldown decreased from 90 to 68. ***Attack cooldown decreased from 10 to 1. **''Switch Path'' ability changed. ***Attack cooldown decreased from 5 to 1. **''Laser Sweep'' ability changed. ***Freeze time decreased from 12 to 7.5. ***Damage increased from 10,000 to 25,000. ***Cooldown decreased from 120 to 60. ***Attack cooldown decreased from 15 to 0.75. *[[Ice Beacon]] health increased from 15,000 to 20,000 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *[[Giant Skeleton]] health decreased from 5,000 to 1,800. *Updated lobby and intermission lobby. *[[Summer Castle]] difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|VeryEasy}} difficulty. *Summoned enemies now use the display name of the enemy they were summoned by instead of their internal name. *Fixed [[Giant Skeleton]] having 5,000 health in [[Badlands II]]. *Fixed [[Frozen]], [[Snowman]], [[Packed Ice]], and [[Deep Freeze]] having no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *Fixed [[Cold Mist]] not having a chain around its neck. *Fixed [[Cold Mist]] being difficult to select when doing so on its arms. *Fixed [[Cold Mist]] unable to be hit with [[Gatling Gun]]'s ''FPS'' ability when targeting certain parts of its arm. *Fixed [[Frost Invader]], [[Deep Freeze]] and [[Frost Hunter]] creating [[Breaker4]] death particles on death. *Fixed [[Frost Ravager]] using [[Fallen Shield]]'s animations, though the new animations are completely broken. *Fixed [[Easy Mode|Easy]] and [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode using outdated icons in the [[Index]]. :In
